{{Quote|I serve at Admiral Ranken's pleasure. She's an unparalleled strategist and I trust her with my life.|Krovos|<ref name="Kuat">{{TORcite|exp=starfighter|type=flashpoint|Kuat Drive Yards}}</ref>}}
'''Darth Krovos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
[[File:Lord_Krovos.png|thumb|left|200px|Lord Krovos during the Battle of Kuat]]
As a young [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]], Krovos survived her training on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by convincing her fellow students to work together to complete their final trials to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] tombs. By doing so, all the acolytes emerged victorious from the trial. Though this angered her [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]], the other students threatened to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the overseer if any harm was done to Krovos. This unique approach to her trials caught the eye of [[Darth Decimus]], who took her as an apprentice.<ref name="Codex" />

As an apprentice, her victories following Korriban gained her recognition and she fought alongside the Empire's most notorious Sith such as [[Darth Marr]] and [[Darth Malgus]]. Krovos went on to climb the ranks of the Empire as her career advanced.<ref name="Codex" /> In [[3637 BBY]] she was working alongside [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Zasha Ranken]], whom she developed a deep respect for. At the time of the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle of Kuat]] she served as Ranken's right hand, overseeing the course of the battle and directing an Imperial strike team to their objectives on the [[Kuat/Legends|Kuati]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]].

She would later rise to the position of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] during the intervening years, and would sit on the [[Dark Council]] by [[3627 BBY]], as Head of [[Sphere of Military Command|Military Command]] - a newly created seat that oversaw the former Spheres of [[Sphere of Defense of the Empire|Defense of the Empire]], [[Sphere of Military Offense|Military Offense]] & [[Sphere of Military Strategy|Military Strategy]].<ref name="State of the Galaxy" /> In this position, she commanded Imperial forces at the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]].<ref name="ObjectiveMeridian">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=Flashpoint|Objective: Meridian}}</ref>

==Personality==
[[File:DarthKrovos.png|thumb|right|200px|Darth Krovos on the Dark Council]]
Krovos was a reformist who supported the inclusion of non-[[Human/Legends|Humans]] and non-Sith in the ranks of the Empire and believed that the wisdom of those without [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] should be acknowledged.<ref name="Heartsandminds">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Hearts and Minds|[[Odessen]]}}</ref> Krovos believed that cooperation and unity could achieve the Empire's goals more easily compared to needless infighting. Though Krovos amassed great power in the Empire, she still recognized the talent of others, including those who were not Sith.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Krovos first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter|''Galactic Starfighter'']] expansion to the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. She is voiced by [[Laura Bailey]].<ref>''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' {{c|credits}}</ref> In the Imperial storyline of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion, Krovos traveled to the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]] to investigate the whereabouts of Darth Malgus along with [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] and [[Darth Rivix]]. Darth Krovos expressed disbelief in the possibility that Malgus could have chosen to betray the Empire and go rogue.<ref name="Secrets">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref> After Malgus is defeated on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]], Krovos will arrive to help restrain him with the Force and arrest him.<ref name="Ruins of Nul">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=flashpoint|Ruins of Nul}}</ref>
